description: This Kotlin file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. The fragment builds a comprehensive home screen UI with a top navigation bar, hero banner, 'Seguí viendo' (Continue Watching) section, and 'Canales de TV' (TV Channels) section. It manages UI layout, focus behavior, data loading via ViewModel and repositories, and dynamic updates based on data fetch states.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass implementing the main home screen of the Android TV app, including layout setup, focus management, data observation, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel instances based on app configuration.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Builds the main view hierarchy, setting up scroll views, containers, and UI sections with proper overscan-safe padding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, subscribes to ViewModel state changes, and triggers initial data load.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes live data changes from the ViewModel to update UI components accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Shows error message and schedules retry for data fetching.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching horizontal scroll with fetched items.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV Channels horizontal scroll with fetched channels.

methods.name: setupTopNavigation
methods.description: Builds the top navigation bar with logo, menu items, and user avatar, applying focus and touch behavior suitable for TV navigation.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates a hero banner placeholder with focus effect.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Seguí viendo' section with title, loading indicator, and horizontally scrollable cards.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Builds the 'Canales de TV' section with title, loading indicator, and horizontally scrollable list.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility method converting dp units to pixels for layout dimensions.
